description: Source code for AssetManager class handling Android assets, including fallback font path logic, temporary file management, and asset opening/closing functions.

classes.name: AssetManager
classes.description: Manages Android assets, providing methods to open assets, manage temporary files, and handle fallback font paths.

methods.name: AssetManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing temporary directory and clearing it.

methods.name: AcquireInternalFd
methods.description: Allocates a unique internal file descriptor.

methods.name: TempFilepath
methods.description: Generates a temporary file path for a given internal fd.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens an asset, falling back to system font path if not found, and creates a temporary POSIX file for the asset.

methods.name: IsAssetFd
methods.description: Checks if a file descriptor corresponds to an asset.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes a file descriptor, deletes associated temporary file.

methods.name: ClearTempDir
methods.description: Removes all files in the temporary directory and recreates it.
